notes.title: Red Brim 0.24
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/aiGviuC.jpeg

Hey everyone, it’s just me here, your one-and-only dev. Dropping in to say thank you for sticking around. I know you’ve been waiting, and I’m sorry it took longer than usual. This scene turned out trickier than I expected, so I really went the extra mile to make it pop. It’s a big one for the main plot, no spoilers, promise! but I think you’re gonna love it.

Anyway… Update 0.24 is up now on Patreon! Here’s what’s new:

🛠️ Changelog 0.24

Main quest continues.

New scene with Miss Blue — (13 new images!).

New location: The Industries — (4 fresh images!).

Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: 🎉 Update 0.20 Is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m super excited to share Red Brim Update 0.20 with you all. This update has a some new content and fixes, and I’ve been looking forward to hearing what you think. Here’s what’s new:

Changelog 0.20:


 🕵️‍♂️ Continued the main storyline—more drama, mystery, and surprises to uncover!
 👥 Introduced two new characters: Miss Blue and Mister Brown. They bring a whole new dynamic to the future story.
 🔥 Added a brand-new scene featuring Isabel and Bea, complete with 12 new images.
 🎶 Isabel now has her own main theme song
 🐛 Fixed some frustrating button bugs for Android users.
 ✨ Polished up a few features for a smoother experience overall.


Changelog 0.19


 Continued questline for Taylin
 A new scene with Taylin, complete with two animated sequences (18 images!)
 Minor bug fixes to keep things running smoothly

notes.title: 🚀Red Brim 0.18: Bea’s Discoveries, What’s Next?🚀
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Got some exciting stuff for you in this new update! The story between Simon and Bea is getting deeper, and we're starting to peel back some of the layers of mystery. Bea learns a few more secrets, but what she'll do with that knowledge... well, you’ll have to wait and see! 👀

I’ve made progress in the main quest, added new scenes, and of course, squashed a few bugs along the way. Check out the full changelog below!

Changelog 0.18:


 Advanced the main quest
 Added one new scene with Bea (12 images)
 Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Release Update: Version 0.17 of Red Brim Now Live
notes.content:
https://i.postimg.cc/gc5RJBjZ/new-release.jpg

Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce the release of Red Brim version 0.17! In this update, we've advanced two key quests: "Love Letter" with Taylin and "Awakening Desire" with Lora. Additionally, I've included two new scenes with Lora, one of which is animated, to enrich your experience.

I've also tackled and resolved several bugs to ensure smoother gameplay.


Changelog V 0.17:


 Advanced the "Love Letter" quest with significant progress involving Taylin.
 Continued the "Awakening Desire" quest with Lora, enhancing her storyline.
 Added two new scenes with Lora, including one animated scene. (18 images)
 Resolved several bugs to improve game stability and performance.
